summary: Sandbach United came from a midweek defeat at Foley Meir to face Stafford Town in their opening day fixture, with ex-Bach players Sam Lynch and Callum Parker featuring for the visitors. The Bach took the lead through Tatters in the 30th minute after a keeper error, and went into the break 1-0 up while maintaining a clean sheet despite some nervous moments including a Stafford shot hitting the post. The match saw an injury to Mitch Nolan and a yellow card for a late challenge, with the team looking to secure all three points in the second half.
